checks.command:
python3 -c '
import json, os, pathlib
s = os.environ["VERIFY_SNAPSHOT"]
programme = json.load(open(s + "/programme.json"))
row = next(p for p in programme["projects"] if p["key"] == "S01")
text = open(s + "/../docs/outputs.js").read()
index = json.loads(text[text.find("{"):text.rfind("}") + 1])
outputs = [o for o in index["outputs"] if o.get("project_id") == row["id"]]
assert outputs, "S01 publishes no output"
pages = []
for o in outputs:
    if o.get("path"):
        pages.append(pathlib.Path(s).parent.joinpath("docs", pathlib.Path(o["path"]).name).read_text())
body = "\n".join(pages).lower()
assert "not recoverable" in body, "the decision record does not mark an unrecoverable value"
'
